Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:34270

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 13810 of 2022
Applicant :- Smt. Shyara
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Kunwar Ravi Prakash,Rakesh Dwivedi,Sheikh Wali Uz Zaman
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Nishant Srivastava,Vivek Kumar Singh
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1 .  The learned counsel for the applicant has filed an application for correction/ modification in the memo of bail application, the same is taken on record.

2. By means of the aforesaid correction/ modification application seeks permission for correction/modification of the description in the name of the applicant as Smt Shyara Banoo @
Shakeela in place of Smt. Shyara in the memo of the bail application.
3. The application named sought is formal in nature.
The application is allowed.
4. The learned counsel for the applicant may carry out the amendment forthwith.

(Order on bail application)
5.
Heard Sri Rakesh Dwivedi, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Manoj Kumar Sahu, the Smt. Shyara vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

learned A.G.A. for the State as well as Sri Nishant Srivastava, learned counsel for the informant and perused the record.

6. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
103 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 306 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Prohibition Act,
registered at Police Station Auras, District Unnao.

7. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 18.06.2022 against four named accused persons, including the applicant, stating that the informant had got his daughter married to the applicant's son Ansar (co-accused) about 6 years ago; that the applicant's son used to harass her for demanding dowry and at 10:00 pm on 17.06.2022, co-accused Ekrar and the applicant caught hold of the informant's daughter and the applicant's son Ansar poured petrol or kerosene at her and set her ablaze.

8. The learned counsel for the informant has filed a counter affidavit annexing therewith copies of the statement recorded during investigation and one Faizan, who stated that he lives in a house opposite to the applicant's house and he had reached on the spot after hearing the cries and so that the deceased had set herself ablaze.

9. The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that co-accused Ekrar has already been granted bail by means of an order dated 12.05.2023 passed by a coordinate bench of this Court through Neutral Citation No.2023:AHC-LKO:33283 in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 423 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 423 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
10. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.
11.

Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the F.I.R assigned the role of catching hold to the co-accused Ekrar and the applicant and the co-accused Ekrar has already been granted bail and the statement of witness Faizan, who stated that the deceased set herself ablaze, coupled with the fact that the applicant is a 61 years old lady having no criminal history and she is languishing in jail since 01.08.2022 and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail in the aforesaid case.
12. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

13. Let the applicant- Smt Shyara Banoo @ Shakeela be released on bail in Case Crime No. 103 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 306 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Prohibition Act,
registered at Police Station Auras, District Unnao, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to the following conditions: -
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
Smt. Shyara vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 17 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16278728/
2 (ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
14.
